e: AdministratorAccess is an AWS managed identity-based policy granting full access, and attaching it to the IAM group gives all five users full access. Resource-based policies can't be attached to IAM groups, and SystemAdministrator isn't full access.

SQS FIFO queues provide exactly-once processing (deduplication) as a managed messaging layer, and Lambda for the compute layers requires the least infrastructure management. SNS can't guarantee exactly-once delivery, and EC2 or EKS require managing infrastructure.

AWS Transfer for SFTP is a managed, highly available SFTP endpoint, EFS provides shared file storage that the batch EC2 instances can mount with no application change, and an Auto Scaling group with scheduled scaling runs the nightly batch with minimal effort. Self-managed SFTP servers need operations, and the S3 option requires modifying the application.

ALBs support AWS WAF for protection against common web exploits for the HTTP application, and Global Accelerator provides static IP addresses plus improved availability and performance across Regions. WAF can't be attached to NLBs, and CloudFront doesn't provide static IPs.

RDS Proxy pools connections (fixing the too-many-connections errors) and shortens failover time by keeping application connections and routing to the new writer, reducing failover time substantially. The other options move to different engines.

An S3 Object Lambda Access Point runs a Lambda function that redacts the PII as files are read, so the provider always sees the most recent conversations without PII, with a serverless design that scales and needs no batch processes or copies.

A CloudWatch alarm with the EC2 recover action automatically recovers the instance (same instance ID, IP addresses, and EBS volumes) on a system status check failure, improving recovery time without changing code or running more than one instance. Termination protection, Multi-AZ for a single instance, or RAID don't recover from instance failures.

ECS with service auto scaling and a minimum of three tasks spread across Availability Zones is highly available with little operational overhead and no application changes to the containers. Self-managed EKS nodes or EC2 fleets add management, and Lambda isn't a container host for existing containerized workloads.

Newer, more-demanded movies stay in S3 Intelligent-Tiering, and older movies go to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval, where expedited retrieval typically returns data within 1 to 5 minutes, meeting the 5-minute requirement at lower storage cost. Standard retrieval takes hours, and bulk even longer.
ECS on Fargate is serverless, and mounting an EFS volume provides the 50 GB of temporary storage with low overhead. Lambda can't mount S3 or EBS volumes, and ECS on EC2 isn't serverless.

A custom identity broker application on premises authenticates users against LDAP and uses AWS STS to get temporary credentials (or a federated console sign-in URL), which works when the directory isn't SAML-compatible. IAM Identity Center needs SAML or a connected directory, and rotating IAM credentials is impractical.

A Recycle Bin retention rule retains deleted AMIs (and their snapshots) for a set period so they can be recovered quickly with little operational work. Copying AMIs or snapshots to other accounts or S3 requires ongoing management.

150 TB over a 100 Mbps link at night only would take far longer than a month, so physical transfer is needed. Multiple Snowball devices are cheaper than Snowmobile (which is for exabyte-scale), and Transfer Acceleration or VPN are limited by the bandwidth.

Lifting the web and application tiers onto EC2 instances and the MySQL database to RDS for MySQL makes the fewest architectural changes, and RDS offers point-in-time restore with automated backups and low operational overhead. Aurora or public database subnets change more or reduce security.

An SQS access policy (a resource-based queue policy) can grant another AWS account permission to poll the queue directly, without that company giving up its own account permissions. IAM policies and instance profiles only apply within an account, and SNS policies don't control the queue.

Systems Manager Session Manager gives secure shell access to instances in private subnets with no bastion hosts, open SSH ports, or VPNs, authenticated by IAM, at no extra cost beyond the instance role (AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore). Bastions and VPNs cost more and need maintenance.

A cached volume gateway keeps the full dataset in S3 and a local cache of frequently accessed data for immediate access with minimal lag, reducing capital expenses on storage arrays. File gateways, DataSync, or EFS over VPN don't give the same low-lag access to the active subset through block volumes.

DynamoDB point-in-time recovery lets you restore the table to any second in the last 35 days, with a single setting and no operational work. AWS Backup, Lambda backups, or streams are more complex or lack per-second granularity.

An S3 object-created event notification invoking a Lambda function processes each file within seconds, scales automatically from a few files to hundreds of concurrent uploads, and costs only for the processing time. Kinesis, SNS-only, or CloudTrail with AppSync are unnecessary or don't process files.

Production runs constantly, so Compute Savings Plans lower its cost (and cover EC2 and Lambda), while nonproduction instances used only during weekday business hours run On-Demand and are shut down when idle, which beats committing to reservations. Dedicated Hosts and Reserved Instances for intermittent use cost more.

Use AWS SCT to convert the Oracle schema to Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS DMS to migrate the existing data and replicate ongoing changes (CDC) over the VPN. Full-load-only DMS, DataSync, or Snowball approaches don't capture changes during the migration.

ECS with Fargate and EKS with Fargate are managed container services with serverless compute that scale per service without any servers to manage. EC2 worker node options require managing instances, and Lambda isn't the way to run existing Docker containers behind API Gateway.

An Auto Scaling group that scales out as traffic increases using a launch template with a preconfigured AMI launches new instances quickly and you pay only for the capacity you need. Overprovisioning or stopped-instance schemes cost more, and caching alone can't handle dynamic traffic.

The AWS Config managed rule restricted-ssh checks security groups for SSH open to 0.0.0.0/0, and an SNS notification on noncompliance alerts the company, enabled in minutes with no code. Lambda scripts or SCP-based workflows take more effort.

VPC Lattice provides service-to-service connectivity across VPCs and accounts for Lambda and EKS services, with HTTPS listeners and a built-in service registry (service network and service directory) for discovery, with the least administrative overhead. Network Firewall, PrivateLink per service, or peering add far more management.
